Dana (release-manager): Heads-up: regional rollout for v4.1 will be staggered this week. Starting 02:00 UTC we'll apply a temporary release freeze for APAC region services (72 hours) while partner traffic validations complete. This is targeted to api-gateway, routing, and rate-limiter.
Omar (infra): Ack. Does this affect global canaries or only APAC regions?
Dana (release-manager): Only APAC. Global and EU/NA trains proceed as normal. We do want to bump rate-limit thresholds for partner trials in APAC to 2x for telemetry only. Any production overrides require approval from me + Omar.
Priya: Noted. I'll add a one-line entry to the weekly changelog under "Regional rollouts": "APAC v4.1 staggered rollout + temporary rate-limit increase for partner trials (ticket REL-1102)".
Ravi (partner-eng): We're coordinating with PartnerX to shift their traffic window to 03:00-06:00 UTC to align with low-latency checks. Will confirm once they accept.
Zoe (oncall): Escalation thresholds: if APAC p95 > 2.5s for 10m or error rate > 1% for 5m, auto-revert regional changes and page @infra. Also, any sustained token errors should trigger security page.
Omar (infra): We'll pre-configure the revert playbook and a canary test in APAC with 5 nodes at 10rps. DeployBot will need `regional-revert` enabled for the group.
DeployBot: Action: regional-freeze(APAC) scheduled by Dana at 02:05 UTC. Whitelist: partner-canary-tag allowed with rate-limit override. CI triggers for APAC routing and rate-limiter suspended.
Dana (release-manager): For engineering: please avoid merges touching rate-limiter config or routing rules for APAC until freeze lifts. If you must, ping me with a rollback plan.
Priya: I'll push the changelog note and update Release Train doc with the partner window.
Ravi (partner-eng): PartnerX confirmed window and will route initial traffic through partner-canary only. We'll monitor with you.
Zoe (oncall): Dashboard links: https://dash.internal.redwood/boards/apac-rollout and https://dash.internal.redwood/alerts/release-train. I'll post a mid-window status at 04:00 UTC and final lift notice when cleared.
Dana (release-manager): Thanks. Plan: freeze start 02:00 UTC -> monitor canary -> decide resume/extend by 14:00 UTC. Will post updates here. :white_check_mark:
